description: This file defines an Android Fragment class (`LogFragment`) that manages a log display within an app, utilizing a custom `LogView` to output log data received via the `LogNode` interface. It sets up a scrollable view with stylized text for logging purposes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that encapsulates a log view with scrolling and styling capabilities, designed to display log messages received through a logging interface.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and initializes the ScrollView and LogView components, sets layout parameters, style, padding, and returns the constructed view hierarchy.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Standard Fragment lifecycle method that inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the internal LogView instance for external use.
